description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lingering Tormentor
When Lingering Tormentor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lingering Tormentor enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lingering Tormentor
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
